name: Shy Earwig 18
author: satyamchaudharydev
description: Gradient rounded pink toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #f4f4f5 to #303136, left becomes calc(100% - (1.4em + 0.3em)), background changes from #f4f4f5 to #303136.
